'''December 2000 Huntsville tournament (23 December)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Huntsville, AL on 23 December 2000. [[Andy McClure]] won it. It is known from Andy McClure's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1574">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-24-huntsville-al-12-23-00d1574/ huntsville-al-12-23-00], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 24 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-24-huntsville-al-12-23-00d1574/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Huntsville, AL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy McClure]]
